nudges.overtime: After hours: the timer is still running when your workday ends

nudge.idleBody: Start the timer on whatever you're working on.

modeHint.flowtime: Work until you decide to stop; the break is a fifth of what you worked.
modeHint.countdown: One block of the minutes you choose.
